title: 3-D shapes
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between an edge and a vertex?
Can you show me an object that is a cylinder?
Does everything have faces, edges, and vertices?

explain.say: Solid shapes are called 3-D shapes. You can pick them up. A dice is a cube.
Look at the cube and the cuboid. Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
A flat side of a solid shape is called a face. A cube has six square faces.
An edge is where two faces meet. A corner is called a vertex. A cube has eight vertices.

draw.text: Vertices: the corners. A cube has 8.

explain.say: A ball is a sphere. It is round all over. It has one curved surface.
A tin of beans is a cylinder. It has two flat circles and one curved surface.
A cone has one flat circle at the bottom. It has a point at the top.

faq.q: What is the difference between a face and an edge?
faq.a: A face is a flat surface on the shape. An edge is the straight line where two faces join together.
asks: Where do faces and edges meet?

faq.a: No, not all shapes have vertices. A perfectly round sphere has no sharp points or corners.
The sphere rolls the best because it is perfectly round all over. A cylinder also rolls very well.
asks: Which shape is best for rolling?

faq.a: A cylinder is shaped like a tin of soup. It has two flat, round faces and one curved surface between them.
asks: Name a shape like a can.
What shape is like a tube?

faq.a: Yes, a cone has one edge. It is the curved edge around its flat circle.
asks: Does the cone have any lines?
Where is the edge on a cone?

facts: A cube has six square faces.
A sphere has one curved surface. It has no flat faces, edges or vertices.
A cylinder has two circular faces and one curved surface.
The cone has one circular face and a single vertex at its tip.

quiz.say: Look at the ball. Tap the name of its shape.
quiz.why: A ball is round all over. That shape is a sphere.

wrong.0: A cube has flat square faces, like a dice.
wrong.2: A cone has a point at the top, like an ice cream cone.

quiz.say: Look at the tin. Tap the name of its shape.
quiz.why: A tin has two flat circles and one curved surface. That shape is a cylinder.

wrong.1: A cone has one flat circle and a point at the top.
wrong.2: A sphere is round all over, like a ball.

quiz.say: Count the faces on a dice. Tap how many.
quiz.why: A dice is a cube. It has six faces, with one number on each face.

wrong.0: Turn the dice over, because the top and bottom are faces too.
wrong.1: Eight is the number of corners, and faces are the flat sides.
